description.value: Chungchun is a Korean rice dog (corn dog) franchise location on busy Robson Street in downtown Vancouver. It specializes in crispy battered rice-flour hot dogs with a variety of toppings and coatings. As a takeout-only window, it offers a quick grab-and-go snack for cyclists passing through the West End.
